Step title: The Importance of Relationships for Academic Success
Content Outline: This lesson explores why strong relationships are fundamental for academic and personal success
Learner Profile: The target audience profile is for online learners at Excel High School. The audience is 13-18 years old, primarily engaged in asynchronous online learning, with varied prior knowledge and technology access. They prefer self-paced learning and diverse media. Content creation guidelines emphasize a 7th-9th grade reading level, clear and concise language, active voice, and short sentences. Structurally, content should have one idea per paragraph, frequent headings, numbered steps for instructions, and bullet points for lists. Visual elements like images, diagrams, and short videos are encouraged. Engagement strategies include connecting to real-world applications, maintaining a supportive tone, and incorporating self-assessment opportunities. Formatting best practices suggest bolding important terms, using ample white space, and consistent formatting.
What is the rationale for this step: To establish the foundational importance of connections for student growth and highlight its academic benefits.
